name: Somalia, Fed. Rep.
headline: Somalia, Fed. Rep.: +3.1% growth in 2025, 3.7% inflation
sections: Somalia, Fed. Rep. is a $13.2 billion economy (2025), the world's 150th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.1% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $1,643 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K.

Consumer prices rose 3.7% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.8% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 18.9% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 34.2% (2025).
The general government balance is −0.3% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −24.3% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Trade equals 128% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 6.4% of GDP (2025).
Life expectancy is 59.0 years (2024). Population: 17.0 million (2025).
